notes.title: Pledge Extra Credit FULL HD update
notes.notes:
Today we've updated visuals!

We were able to transfer 98% of all in game visuals into 1920 x 720 resolution and that means significant improvement in terms of visual quality.

Also a new secret cheat system was implemented - are you able to find the icon triggering it? :)

Have fun!

notes.title: Work in progress: Full HD update
notes.notes:
We've upscaled our low res images and animations into FULL HD resolution. Right now our visuals artist, with huge devotion, is adding cumshots to certain images and probably next week we'll be able to update our game on STEAM with high quality images.

We also plan to add CHEAT system for those who want to get every scenes and endings faster.
